name: Fairness Benchmarking for AI-Generated Face Detection
description: This task involves evaluating the fairness of AI-generated face detectors using the SynthBench-2024 dataset, which includes demographically annotated real and AI-generated face images from diverse generation methods (Deepfake Videos, GANs, and Diffusion Models). The goal is to assess and improve fairness across demographic groups such as skin tone, gender, and age.

cr:input.name: SynthBench-2024 Dataset
cr:input.description: A dataset containing 400,885 real face images and 1,245,660 AI-generated face images annotated with demographic attributes (skin tone, gender, and age). The dataset includes images from 28 subsets and 37 generation methods, such as FF++, DFDC, GANs, and Diffusion Models.

cr:output.name: predictions
cr:output.description: The output consists of fairness evaluation results for AI-generated face detectors, including performance metrics disaggregated by demographic groups (e.g., skin tone, gender, age).

field.name: detector_id
field.description: Identifier for the AI face detector being evaluated, e.g., 'detector_001'.

field.name: demographic_group
field.description: The demographic group being evaluated, e.g., 'Skin Tone: Tone 1', 'Gender: Male', 'Age: Adult (25-44)'.

field.name: fairness_metric_value
field.description: The fairness metric value for the detector on the specified demographic group, e.g., 0.85.
